description: Claude pricing for every Anthropic model: USD per million input and output tokens, context length, max output and modalities for Claude Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and the newer families, cheapest first, plus the cost of your call when you give token counts. Filter by name (q=sonnet), price cap, context or image input. Source: OpenRouter's public model list. Use to pick a Claude model for a job or to estimate what a prompt will cost before sending it. Example: q=sonnet. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of your call, to estimate its cost

maxInputPrice.description: Only models at or under this USD per million input tokens

minContext.description: Only models with at least this context length in tokens

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of your call, to estimate its cost

provider.description: Provider to list (default anthropic); any other provider name works too, e.g. google, meta-llama, mistralai

q.description: Words in the model id or name, e.g. gpt, claude, llama 70b

sort.description: input (default), output, blended (3:1 input:output) or context

vision.description: true: only models that take image input

name: claude_pricing
title: Claude pricing: Anthropic API prices
